description: Fork of exp257 (TinyMHLut(soft) + noise=0.002 -> 1.6060). Swap backward_mode='soft' for backward_mode='ste' with n_alternatives=3 (new multi-alt STE backward: TinyMHL-fast forward + MultiHeadLut-style uncertainty backward + same bernoulli noise). Apples-to-apples vs exp257 — isolates the soft-pipeline backward's contribution above n_alt=3 uncertainty backward. Comparators: exp257=1.6060 (soft+noise), exp234=1.6212 (STE n_alt=1, no noise), exp261=TBD (MultiHeadLut smooth=False, n_alt=3, noise).
